question: For prime-order E/F_p with N not dividing p-1, is the canonical Miller primitive U(kP)=f_{N,P}(kP)^(1/N) (K1: unique primitive of the line-function cocycle; K2: U((k+1)P)=gamma*U(kP)/(x_P-x_kP), the elliptic-net/EDS ratio form) character-flat in k over Z/N and equidistributed in F_p^*, as a random function would be, when the same detector finds the planted character at N | p-1?

claims.text: U=f^(1/N) is a degree-N rational function on E/G, the Kummer generator of F_p(E/G)/F_p(E) (textbook Kummer theory; Hilbert 90 for mu_N over F_p). Recalled, not decided by this experiment; the ideation report's test (a) (evaluate on a Velu model of E/G) is circular or infeasible at toy cost and is dropped.
K1: for every sampled admissible pair (R,S) on every cell, U(R)U(S)/U(R+S) = eps * g_{R,S}(P) with g=line(R,S)/vertical(R+S) evaluated at P and eps a single sign fixed per curve.

K2: on every cell, U((k+1)P)(x_P-x_{kP})/U(kP) is one constant gamma for all admissible k (telescoped form), and the division-polynomial form U(kP)=c*r_k*gamma^k with r_k=psi_{k-1}(P)/psi_k(P) holds with c,gamma fitted from k=2,3.

On candidate cells (N not dividing p-1) the non-DC Fourier spectrum of chi_a(U(kP)) over the k-window, maximised over the frozen multiplier set, is not above the random-function null, and the DC (marginal) channel is not above it either.
claims.if_supported: closure of both leads at toy scale is recommended (U behaves as a hash of the point beyond the EDS recursion)
claims.if_not_supported: a flagged cell goes to fresh-seed replication; two replicated flags reopen the leads and need independent review before any reading

claims.text: The same code path finds the Tate-character peak at N | p-1 on every positive-control cell, and finds planted linear-phase amplitude eps>=eps_min on candidate sequences; otherwise a null on C3 is invalid, not a null.
claims.if_supported: the C3 null is admissible, with minimum detectable amplitude reported
claims.if_not_supported: instrument blind: C3 verdict is invalid_measurement

claims.text: The smooth-(p-1) instrument makes the 48/56/64-bit windows computable; results there are local-window statements (contiguous and strided windows of 2^16 points of a group of order ~2^48..2^64), not full-group spectra.

hypotheses.statement: U is a hash of the point beyond the closed EDS recursion: K1 and K2 hold exactly and the spectrum of chi_a(U(kP)) is flat (add-one empirical p >= alpha/m on every candidate cell and channel). This is what the lead's own analysis predicts.
hypotheses.mechanism: U is a degree-N function on E/G whose divisor is supported on non-rational points; Weil/Perel'muter bounds are vacuous at degree N~p, so flatness is measured, not proved; K2 shows log U is a prefix sum of -log(x_P-x_kP)+const, an inversion of a pseudo-random walk.

power.note: Family = 104 candidate cells (80 T1 + 24 T2 windows) x 2 channels (AC, DC) = 208. Empirical add-one p with doubled tail from 10000 random-function null draws per size class: min p = 2/10001 = 1.9998e-4 < alpha/m = 2.404e-4, so a cell must exceed all 10000 draws of its class to be flagged. This is resolution only. Detection power is argued separately: a linear-phase component of amplitude eps adds eps^2*M to the Exp(1)-mean power, the critical power is about ln(|A|*M)+ln(10000) (max of 24 x M Exp(1) bins, then the 1e-4 tail), i.e. 19.3, 22.1, 23.5, 24.9 at M=2^10, 2^14, 2^16, 2^18, so eps_min ~= 1.1*sqrt(t_crit/M): about 0.15, 0.04, 0.02, 0.011; the planted arm measures this directly. Outside that amplitude the null is silent.

Not measured: only a sub-minute Python probe of K1/K2 at p=1009 was run. Time one call per arm first.

primary.name: K1 pass rate
primary.definition: over sampled admissible (R,S) with R,S,R+S not in {O,P} and no Miller collision, U(R)U(S)/U(R+S)=eps*g_{R,S}(P) with one eps per curve; 2000 pairs per cell

primary.name: K2 pass rate
primary.definition: over every admissible k in the window (T1: all) or the 2^16 window plus 2000 random k (T2): telescoped constancy of U((k+1)P)(x_P-x_kP)/U(kP), and the division-polynomial form after fitting c,gamma from k=2,3

primary.name: max normalised AC power
primary.definition: max over a in A and bins j not in {0,L/2} of the mean-removed padded DFT power; mean power 1 under the null
primary.formula: max_{a,j} |DFT_L(z^(a) - mean)(j)|^2 / M, z^(a)_k = exp(2 pi i a ell_k/(p-1))

primary.name: empirical AC p-value
primary.definition: 2*(1+#{null draws of the class with t_ac >= observed})/(n+1), capped at 1, n=10000

primary.name: empirical DC p-value
primary.definition: same construction for the DC power |sum_k z^(a)_k|^2/M maximised over A

primary.name: positive-control detections
primary.definition: order-N-character channel p_ac < alpha/m and argmax bin within +-1 of the bin predicted by log t(P,P)

secondary.name: U value collisions
secondary.definition: count over the window, against Poisson mean M^2/(2(p-1)); stands in for the 'ratio success' of the lead, whose definition the lead text does not give

secondary.name: charged field operations
secondary.definition: Montgomery mul (M), sqr (S), inversion (I, one count whatever the algorithm) called through the Fp type in Miller, root exponentiation, PH log and curve arithmetic; FFT flops and PRF calls listed uncharged

secondary.name: planted detection rate
secondary.definition: fraction of planted runs with p_ac < alpha/m, 6 cells (2 each in classes s14,s16,s18) x 4 eps x 5 seeds

stopping_rules.rule: fixed design: 104 candidate cells, 4 exact-only s20 cells, 15 positive-control cells, 24 A/A cells, 24 planted runs x 5 seeds, 10000 null draws x 5 classes, then stop
conditional replication stage: only if a candidate cell has p_ac or p_dc below alpha/m, run its 8 pre-listed REP cells (same class, seeds from the protocol hash), then stop
a failed K1 or K2 check on any cell stops the spectrum stage for that curve only and is reported; a positive-control miss marks the whole spectrum verdict invalid_measurement

invalidation_rules: rows where both Miller chains collide are excluded from spectrum and counted (cap 1% of the window, else the cell is excluded and reported)
a cell whose recorded #E or order of P fails the checker is excluded and replaced by the next seed index, logged

decision_rule.text: Instrument gate first: pos_detect must be 15/15 and the neg-random-fn null must pass its calibration (analytic-vs-empirical tail comparison reported; no neg-shuffle cell flagged) or the verdict is invalid_measurement. Then K1/K2: any failure withdraws K1 (record) or K2 (EDS form) per the idea's own rule and leaves the leads open. Then spectrum: a cell is FLAGGED if p_ac or p_dc < 0.05/208 (it exceeds all 10000 null draws). No flag: closure_confirmed. A DC-only flag is reported as marginal non-uniformity with no k-dependence (not a reopen). An AC flag triggers the 8 REP cells; reopen_candidate iff >=2 of 8 REP cells flag at p_ac < 0.01 (Bonferroni 8) AND the aa-second-base arm shows the peak at the frequency transformed by s^-1 AND neg-shuffle on that cell is not flagged. Reopen needs independent review before any reading.
decision_rule.threshold: empirical p < alpha/m = 2.404e-4 (add-one, n=10000) per cell and channel
decision_rule.statistic: t_ac and DC power per cell against the size-class random-function null
decision_rule.interval: Clopper-Pearson 95% for rates; none for exact checks
decision_rule.effect_size_measure: t_ac in null-mean units, and for planted runs the smallest eps detected at >=90%

inadmissible: regressing out gamma^k or any k-linear term before the DFT (it breaks N-periodicity of the genuine function; the AC spectrum already shows a shifted peak if one exists)
choosing, adding or dropping multipliers, windows, size classes, null draws or the alpha after seeing any p-value
reading a DC-only flag, or a single unreplicated flag, as a transfer signal
reading a flat toy spectrum as a statement about cryptographic sizes, or a 2^16 window of a 2^64 group as a full-group spectrum
any wall-clock claim, any rho comparison, any cost claim: none is made here
dropping positive-control misses, collision cells, or K1/K2 failures
reading p from the analytic Exp(1) cross-check instead of the empirical null
